Geographies Served Programs Women's Entrepreneurship Programme State Bihar Maharashtra States Bihar Maharashtra This programme empowers women through entrepreneurship training and access to seed funding and business expansion loans via microfinance institutions. It facilitates rural marketing and identifies opportunities in health, clean energy, and sanitation. The initiative fosters a network of grassroots entrepreneurs, helping women recognize themselves as entrepreneurs. It establishes an entrepreneurship education course and women-led Resource Center, positively impacting rural villages in Maharashtra and Bihar. Water, Sanitation, Health & Nutrition Programme District Latur Parbhani Osmanabad Nanded Jalna Hingoli Beed Aurangabad - Maharashtra State Maharashtra District Latur Parbhani Osmanabad Nanded Jalna Hingoli Beed Aurangabad - Maharashtra States Maharashtra Swayam Shikshan Prayog (SSP) empowers women in the Marathwada region of Maharashtra to become Arogya Sakhis—community health service providers and entrepreneurs. It uses modern technology to deliver preventive healthcare services, increasing awareness and generating income. This initiative builds women's leadership in decentralized climate risk governance, benefiting families and promoting access to water, sanitation, and nutrition products. Improved access to nutritious food and water security positively impact vulnerable households in climate-threatened regions. SSP also facilitates Government linkages, health camps, and business support for women-led agriculture enterprises. Energy And Environment Programme Swayam Shikshan Prayog's Women’s Entrepreneurship in Clean Energy programme connects rural communities with clean energy solutions through women entrepreneurs known as Sakhis. This public-private partnership model integrates women into the clean energy technology supply chain, providing access to technology, finance, and markets. The Sakhi network facilitates the delivery of clean energy products like cookstoves and solar lamps to rural households. The programme also promotes public awareness, establishes clean energy hubs, and fosters partnerships for product design and marketing. Additionally, the programme expands into health, hygiene, and climate adaptive solutions, sustaining the Sakhi network's impact. Women-Led Climate Resilient Farming District Latur Solapur Osmanabad Nanded State Bihar Kerala Maharashtra District Latur Solapur Osmanabad Nanded States Bihar Kerala Maharashtra The Women-led Climate Resilient Farming (WCRF) model empowers women as farmers, leaders, and change agents, promoting food-secure practices. It focuses on Market Linkages, Federating Women Farmers, Technology Integration, and Water efficient micro irrigation. This model enhances productivity, income, health, nutrition, and resilience. With a supportive ecosystem of partners, it enables women with farm literacy, decision-making abilities, land access, and leadership skills. Recognized with the United Nations Development Program's Equator Prize 2017, this model empowers women farmers to combat climate change, develop enterprises, and stimulate local economies. Milestones & Track Record SSP has received several global awards including the UNDP Equator Prize (2017), UNFCCC Momentum for Change Lighthouse Award (2016), and Schwab Foundation Social Entrepreneur Award (2018-2019). --> --> Leadership Team Devkanya Jagdale Director – Women’s Initiative to learn and lead (WILL) Baby T Varghese Director - Finance & Admin Naseem Shaikh Chief Executive Officer Jiji Sebastian Director – Partnerships, Documentation and Communications Laxmikant Malvadkar Director – IT and Knowledge Management M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AABTS9106N Registration Number 20262 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2016/0095964 --> 80G AABTS9106NF19989 12A AABTS9106NE19981 FCRA 083780808 About Headquarters Pune, Maharashtra Since 1998 Demographies Served Women --> Impact Swayam Shikshan Prayog has reached 6 million people, empowered 350,000 women leaders, worked in 2,320 villages, across 30 districts, and 7 states. Vision and Mission SSP's mission is to promote inclusive, sustainable community development by empowering women at the grassroots in climate-threatened, under-served areas across India. Their vision is to establish women's collectives as farmers and entrepreneurs to enhance economic and social resilience.
